because.label: How to read it
because.value: Players still in the game, found by name (each word you type begins a word of his name; case and accents set aside) and narrowed by the tokens chosen. The list is ordered by playing time this season, most first, and shows the first 300; click a column to sort what is shown. A player's season line is this season's, at the level he played most; "No line" means he hasn't played this season, and "Not known" a part his line doesn't carry.
